create.name: Kaira Jewel Lingo
create.bio:
Kaira Jewel Lingo is a Dharma teacher in two Buddhist lines: the Plum Village Zen tradition of Thich Nhat Hanh and the Insight, or Vipassana, tradition. She grew up in Chicago in an interracial family belonging to an ecumenical Christian community given to simple living and service, and spent several childhood years in Kenya. After studying anthropology at Stanford she travelled to Plum Village in France in 1997, took ordination as a nun two years later and lived as a monastic for fifteen years. Thich Nhat Hanh named her a teacher through Lamp Transmission in 2007, and as a nun she helped lead retreats for families, young people and educators, worked on editing several of his books and helped organise early retreats for people of colour.

Since returning to lay life she has taught around the world, and Spirit Rock has also authorised her to teach Insight meditation. Her retreats and talks combine sitting and walking practice with movement, play, time outdoors and care for the earth, and she keeps a particular commitment to sanghas for Black, Indigenous and people of colour. With her partner, Adam Bucko, she is gathering a Buddhist and Christian community of practice and action. Her book We Were Made for These Times offers ten lessons for meeting change, loss and uncertainty.

books.title: We Were Made for These Times: Ten Lessons on Moving Through Change, Loss, and Disruption
books.author: Kaira Jewel Lingo
books.description: Ten chapters, each pairing a Buddhist teaching with a practice, for times when work, relationships or the wider world are in upheaval. Drawing on her years as a nun and on leaving the monastery in mid-life, she shows how to steady the mind, rest with not knowing and act with care.

courses.title: Annual BIPOC Women's Retreat
courses.description: A weekend residential retreat at the Garrison Institute in New York for women of colour, taught with Marisela Gomez and Valerie Brown. Days include sitting and moving meditation, mindful walking and eating, chanting, writing and small-group sharing.

courses.title: Spiritual Radicals: The Engaged Spirituality of Buddhist and Christian Saints and Bodhisattvas
courses.description: An online afternoon led with Adam Bucko that draws on Buddhist and Christian figures such as Thich Nhat Hanh, Dorothy Day and Dipa Ma. Meditation, prayer and conversation help participants consider how contemplative practice can lead into action.

courses.title: Sunday Sit and Dharma Talk at Insight Santa Cruz
courses.description: A Sunday sitting followed by a Dharma talk from Kaira Jewel, hosted by Insight Santa Cruz in California and open both in person and online.

courses.title: One week Insight Retreat with Gil Fronsdal and Kaira Jewel Lingo
courses.description: A week of silent residential practice at the Insight Retreat Center in California, co-taught with Gil Fronsdal. Sitting and walking periods alternate with instruction, evening talks, work practice and meetings with the teachers; places are given by lottery.

courses.title: Annual Retreat for Black, Indigenous, People of Color
courses.description: A five-day residential retreat at the Garrison Institute for Black, Indigenous and people of colour, taught with Marisela Gomez and Joe Reilly. The theme and full details are still to be announced.

free_resources.title: Kaira Jewel Lingo on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: Her guided meditations and talks on the Insight Timer app, linked from the home page of her website and free to play.

free_resources.title: Videos and Audio
free_resources.description: A page on her website collecting recorded talks, interviews and conversations from recent years, each free to watch or listen to, with a link to her full video library.
